parsed.summary: The PR changes the behavior of the Permutation constructor to handle non-disjoint cycles, but it may introduce a regression risk and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior for users who rely on the current error handling for non-disjoint cycles.
There are no tests added to verify the new behavior of handling non-disjoint cycles.
